display.title: Achdus: All of Us as One
display.summary_short: Only Torah and mitzvos have kept the Jewish people united through the generations, and Hashem blesses us when we stand together as one.
display.summary_long: A short talk on achdus from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that the program's goal is to bring together as many Jewish children as possible through Torah and mitzvos, because from Matan Torah at Har Sinai until today nothing else has bound the Jewish people into one nation. Now more than ever we need Hashem's blessings for lasting peace and the complete Geulah, and we show that we deserve them through unity, friendship and Ahavas Yisroel. This is what we say three times a day in davening: 'Barcheinu Avinu kulanu k'echad', bless us, our Father, because we are all as one. So, especially in these days, let us show brotherly love more than ever, and Hashem will grant our greatest wish: Moshiach now.
display.lesson: When Jews are united in love and friendship, Hashem blesses all of us as one and brings the Geulah closer.

date.note: Cut from episode 133, broadcast on Shiva Asar B'Tammuz 5744. The same talk also aired in episode 32 (summer 1982).
